title: Fixed-offset time travel and a consistent bootstrap loop

finding.title: Mira arrives forty-eight hours before a fixed twenty-four-hour jump
finding.summary: The gate is explicitly fixed at twenty-four hours into the past, but Mira materializes two calendar days before departure.
finding.question: Can Mira's May 10 arrival and the gate's fixed twenty-four-hour offset both be correct?
finding.conflicting_fact_a: The gate moves every traveler exactly twenty-four hours into the past and never varies.
finding.conflicting_fact_b: Mira departs May 12 at 10:00 p.m. and materializes May 10 at 10:00 p.m.
finding.inference_explanation: The explicit forty-eight-hour calendar difference cannot be bridged by the stated fixed offset.

evidence.quote: The gate moves a traveler exactly twenty-four hours into the past. The offset never varies.
Mira materializes at 10:00 p.m. on May 10, 2026.

[scene]INT. CHRONOLOGY LAB - MAY 12, 2026 - 10:00 P.M.
[action]The gate moves a traveler exactly twenty-four hours into the past. The offset never varies.
[action]Mira enters the gate carrying the same blue notebook.

[action]Mira materializes at 10:00 p.m. on May 11, 2026. She writes LEAVE THIS HERE FOR ME TOMORROW and places the blue notebook in Locker 7.
